# gigahost_server (Data Source)

Returns information about a single server, looked up by `id` or `hostname`. The `ips` list carries the IP and subnet IDs needed by `gigahost_server_rdns` and `gigahost_bgp_session`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a server by hostname (or by id).
data "gigahost_server" "example" {
  hostname = "web01"
}

output "server_ip" {
  value = data.gigahost_server.example.primary_ip
}

# The ips list carries the IP and subnet IDs needed by
# gigahost_server_rdns and gigahost_bgp_session.
output "first_ip_id" {
  value = data.gigahost_server.example.ips[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hostname` (String) Server hostname (exact, case-insensitive). Exactly one of `id` or `hostname`.
- `id` (String) Server ID. Exactly one of `id` or `hostname`.

### Read-Only

- `bandwidth` (Number)
- `cores` (Number)
- `created_at` (Number)
- `ips` (Attributes List) IP addresses assigned to the server. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ips))
- `label` (String)
- `location` (String)
- `primary_ip` (String)
- `ram` (Number)
- `status` (Boolean)
- `type` (String)
- `vps_type` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ips`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `id` (String) IP ID — feeds `gigahost_server_rdns.ip_id` and `gigahost_bgp_session.ipv4_ip_id`/`ipv6_ip_id`.
- `reverse` (String)
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet ID — feeds `gigahost_server_rdns.subnet_id`.
- `type` (String)
- `version` (String)
